title: Executive Assistant BRA (Remote)
description:
An Executive Assistant (EA) provides high-level administrative support to executives, senior leaders, or company founders, ensuring their schedules, communications, and daily operations run smoothly . This role acts as a strategic partner, enabling executives to focus on decision-making and leadership responsibilities while the EA manages essential organizational and logistical tasks behind the scenes.

Typical responsibilities include coordinating complex calendars with multiple time zones, organizing and prioritizing meetings, preparing agendas, and ensuring executives are fully briefed ahead of engagements. Executive Assistants also arrange travel itineraries —including flights, accommodations, and transportation—while anticipating potential issues and providing contingency plans.

Beyond scheduling, EAs are often responsible for drafting and editing correspondence , preparing high-quality reports, presentations, and briefing documents , and managing internal and external communications on behalf of the executive. Handling confidential and sensitive information with discretion is critical, as is maintaining a professional demeanor when liaising with board members, clients, and other stakeholders.

An effective EA also monitors project timelines , follows up on action items, and acts as a gatekeeper—managing requests for the executive’s time and attention while balancing competing priorities. They often identify opportunities to streamline processes, implement productivity tools , and enhance the efficiency of the executive office.

Success in this position requires exceptional organizational skills , keen attention to detail, adaptability in fast-paced and high-pressure environments, and excellent communication abilities. The most effective Executive Assistants combine administrative expertise with strategic thinking, becoming an indispensable partner in the achievement of organizational goals.

description:
Accreditation Operations Senior Manager

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. The tournament requires a highly coordinated, secure, and reliable accreditation operation across all venues and official facilities. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Accreditation Operations Senior Manager plays a senior operational leadership role within the FIFA27 Accreditation team, overseeing the coordination and delivery of accreditation operations across the tournament footprint. He/She will be responsible for the end-to-end planning, coordination, and delivery of accreditation operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, ensuring consistent, compliant, and high‑quality service delivery across all tournament venues and official facilities.

Reporting to the FIFA27 Accreditation Senior Manager, and working in close collaboration with FIFA Zürich Accreditation, Technology, Security, Client Groups, and Venue Operations, the role provides operational leadership, governance, and oversight of accreditation centre operations, badge production and distribution, accreditation venue teams, and service delivery standards.

The role provides oversight and guidance to Accreditation Operations Managers and Coordinators and acts as a senior operational escalation point.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Operational Planning & Management

  • Manage the overall accreditation operations strategy across all tournament venues and facilities
  • Define and implement accreditation operational policies, procedures, workflows and service standards in alignment with FIFA requirements
  • Establish and maintain operational timelines, resourcing plans, and risk mitigation measures.
  • Contribute to tournament readiness activities, including operational testing and scenario planning.

Venue & Facilities Management

  • Plan and oversee the delivery of fully equipped Accreditation Centres, including overlay, FF&E, technology, power, lighting, and connectivity.
  • Supervise the setup, operation, and dismantling of accreditation centres and badge distribution points.
  • Ensure venue teams are trained, resourced, and aligned with central accreditation policies and procedures.
  • Coordinate the Accreditation volunteers planning, including shift structures and service levels.
  • Supervise daytoday accreditation centre operations across all venues and facilities.

Badge Production & Distribution Oversight

  • Define requirements and manage procurement of accreditation consumables in line with FIFA27 Inc. standards and timelines.
  • Oversee badge production, quality control, secure storage, logistics, and distribution.
  • Implement robust stock controls, audit processes, and reporting mechanisms across all accreditation facilities.

Team Leadership & Support

  • Lead and manage a team of Accreditation Operations Managers and Coordinators.
  • Support and guide venue‑based accreditation managers, temporary staff and volunteers.
  • Provide training, coaching, and performance oversight to ensure consistent service delivery and operational excellence.

Issue Resolution & Stakeholder Support

  • Act as the final escalation point for complex operational issues related to badge issuance, access rights, or client service.
  • Work closely with the Accreditation Systems, Client Group Managers and Coordinators, Security and Technology teams to resolve operational challenges efficiently.

Compliance, Security & Governance

  • Ensure all accreditation operations comply with FIFA access control policies, data protection requirements, and security protocols.
  • Support venue zoning implementation and access rights validation.
  • Ensure accurate documentation, secure handling of materials, and operational compliance at all times.

Monitoring & Reporting

  • Track operational performance and provide regular operational updates to the FIFA27 Accreditation Senior Manager.
  • Contribute to postevent reporting, lessons learned, and operational debriefs.

YOUR PROFILE

Education & Experience

  • University degree or equivalent higher education in Event Management, Operations, or related field.
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in accreditation and/or major event operations.
  • Proven experience managing venue operations and large‑scale logistics in complex event environments.
  • Familiarity with accreditation systems and access control processes.
  • Experience working in multi‑lingual, high‑pressure environments.
  • Experience with FIFA or major international sporting events or with accreditation Systems is a plus.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong operational leadership and coordination skills.
  • Excellent organisational and logistical planning skills.
  • High attention to detail and operational discipline.
  • Strong stakeholder management and cross‑functional coordination skills.
  • Ability to operate calmly and decisively in time‑critical situations.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, Project) and planning tools.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Knowledge of 3D modelling or planning tools is a plus.

Additional Requirements

  • Eligibility to work in Brazil.
  • Willingness to relocate to Rio de Janeiro for the duration of the contract.
  • Flexibility to work extended hours during critical operational phases.

Somos uma das maiores indústrias de alimentos do Brasil, líderes em massas e biscoitos, com mais de 70 anos de história. Atuamos em diversos segmentos de alimentos, com um portfólio que inclui biscoitos, massas, farinhas, margarinas, bolos, snacks, torradas, chocolates, temperos, molhos, granolas, cookies, pasta de amendoim, panificação sem glúten e beneficiamento de grãos.

Valorizamos o respeito às pessoas e à diversidade, por acreditarmos que ela impulsiona resultados e transformações. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, onde todos são respeitados e reconhecidos por sua autenticidade e potencial, independentemente de idade, gênero, etnia ou orientação sexual.

title: Planning and Integration Manager
description:
Planning and Integration Manager

Department: Administration

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

This role focuses on coordinating operational planning, integration, risk and issue management, to ensure successful delivery of the tournament, hosted in Brazil.

The Project Manager will work with internal and external stakeholders, including FIFA and FIFA27, host cities, government entities, and venue authorities, to achieve excellence in planning, readiness, and execution.

This position offers a unique opportunity to shape the success of one of the most prestigious global sporting events and leave a lasting legacy for women’s football in Brazil and beyond.

The Project Manager will be a key role during tournament time, co-ordinating day-to-day operations at the Tournament Operations Centre and coordinating with stakeholders to resolve issues.

Travel and flexibility to work irregular hours may be required due to the nature of the event.

Project Management and Integration

  • Under the direction of FIFA’s Lead of FWWC Portfolio Management based in Zurich, implement the FIFA Project Management framework throughout the planning, readiness, implementation and closure phases of the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 project.
  • Assist to implement project management processes and standards within FIFA27.
  • Coordinate cross-functional and venue teams to ensure the integration of operational, venue and client planning activities.
  • Collaborate with Functional Areas (FAs) in FIFA27, Host Cities, and stakeholders to develop and implement comprehensive function and venue operating plans (Project Definitions, Operations Plans and Site Operational Plans).
  • Assist in the development of tournament-wide contingency plans and ensure functional area and venue alignment.
  • Assist in the development and maintenance of the master project plan, critical roadmap from a FIFA27 perspective, capturing all key milestones and tasks and the monitoring thereof.
  • Provide strategic and operational support, including tracking progress, risk-issue monitoring, and milestone adherence.

Reporting

  • Assist in the delivery of the Tournament Operations Centre (TOC) structures and systems to facilitate coordination and issue resolution.
  • Provide regular updates and reporting to senior leadership and stakeholders on progress, risks and issues. Help to compile presentations to senior management
  • Compile standardised reports on project progress, risks, and dependencies to ensure alignment with governance structures
  • Data extraction, consolidation and visualisations

Operational and Client Planning

  • Coordinate the development of client and functional operating plans, policies, and procedures using FIFA templates.
  • Assist in the definition and integration of client journey plans in collaboration with key stakeholders.
  • Manage the agreement process for client service levels and priorities.
  • Ensure consistency in planning and delivery across competition and non-competition venues.
  • Support Functional Areas in FIFA27 in preparing and maintaining activity and event schedules, monitoring risks, issues, and resource requirements.

Risk Management

  • Enable risk management processes, including identification, mitigation, and escalation of risks and issues across FIFA27.
  • Ensure compliance with ISO 31000 standards for risk management.
  • Support the development of strategic contingency plans.
  • Work with Functional Areas in FIFA27 to ensure risks are identified, documented and mitigated effectively.

Operational Readiness

  • Plan and conduct readiness exercises, including simulations, rehearsals, and testing of infrastructure, systems, and processes.
  • Build the capability of functional area and venue teams through tailored readiness activities.
  • Capture and implement lessons learned from readiness activities to optimize tournament delivery.
  • Prepare for tournament time by transitioning into the day-to-day coordination and issue management role within the Main Operations Centre.

Knowledge Management

  • Contribute to FIFA’s knowledge management initiatives, including the Observer Program, debriefs, lessons capture, and post-tournament reporting.
  • Ensure proper transfer of knowledge through documentation, photo capture, and archiving of key materials for future events.

Training and Development

  • Provide training to FIFA27 users on FIFA’s project management methodology and tools.
  • Ensure consistent application of project management principles across the organization.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Business, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Knowledge of event planning and project management processes.
  • Familiarity with various project management methodologies, including Agile and Scrum, is an advantage.

Experience

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in leading complex, large-scale projects, preferably in international mega-events or sports events.
  • Proven track record in developing and executing strategic and operational plans.
  • Experience managing stakeholder relationships across government, corporate, and community groups.
  • Expertise in project and risk management, issue management, operational readiness, and contingency planning.
  • Experience in tournament time operations, including incident management and resolution.
  • Experience working in cross-functional, multi-stakeholder and multi-cultural environments.

Certifications

  • Professional certifications such as PMP, APM, or Prince2 is required.

Skills & Competencies

  • Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
  • Experience with project management tools is an asset.
  • A good proficiency in visualisation tools such as Power BI or Tableau for reporting.
  • Familiarity with collaboration tools and systems for managing complex projects.

Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Overlay Cluster Manager
description:
Overlay Cluster Manager

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Overlay Cluster Manager plays a key role in the planning, coordination, and delivery of temporary infrastructure across a group of assigned venues. This position requires close collaboration with the Venue Design team, Functional Areas (FAs), stadium authorities, and various stakeholders to ensure that overlay solutions are functional, cost-effective, and fully aligned with operational needs and technical standards.

Role to transition into onsite Overlay Venue Manager during final Event.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Collaborate with the Venue Design team, Functional Areas, stadium authorities, and key stakeholders to define, optimize, and validate overlay solutions, ensuring technical requirements are accurately reflected in designs and BoQs.
  • Contribute to procurement and tendering processes by preparing technical inputs for RFPs, supporting technical evaluations, and managing overlay contractors and suppliers across assigned venues.
  • Manage change control and budget tracking for venues within the cluster, ensuring scope, cost, and schedule alignment.
  • Coordinate and oversee the flow of technical information, including drawings, requirements, and updates, across all venues in the cluster.
  • Maintain alignment with stadium authorities by monitoring construction schedules, planned renovations, and infrastructure upgrades.
  • Oversee overlay delivery from planning through construction, operations, and reinstatement, ensuring quality, compliance, and timely handover.
  • Track progress, milestones, and deliverables, providing regular status updates and supporting the resolution of risks, issues, and dependencies.
  • Support operational design development by consolidating raw data into compliant base drawings and ensuring consistent coding and naming conventions for effective tracking and change management.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Degree in architecture, engineering, urban planning or a related field.
  • Minimum 7 years or more in infrastructural projects or Overlay/Technical Service roles in Major Events for a Sporting Organization
  • Strong technical knowledge in temporary infrastructure.
  • Excellent organizational, coordination, and communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Autodesk applications (AutoCAD, BIM 360, Autodesk Construction Cloud, etc.)
  • Proficient in MS Office 365 (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project)
  • Right to work in Brazil

  • Availability to travel as needed
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Senior Manager, Special Events
description:
Senior Manager, Special Events

Department: Events & Entertainment

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to the Head of Special Events, the Senior Special Events Manager will serve as a senior leader within the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ organization. This role is a pivotal member of the Local Organizing Structure, working in close collaboration with the FIFA Zurich Project Team, internal functional areas, Host Cities, Commercial Affiliates, Government Authorities, and other key stakeholders to deliver exceptional, world‑class event experiences that elevate the tournament’s global impact.

Role Purpose: The Senior Special Events Manager is responsible for the strategic planning, creative development, operational execution, and overall management of all official FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ special events. The role ensures seamless, high‑quality delivery aligned with FIFA’s brand standards, commercial objectives, and global audience expectations.

Impact & Scope: The Senior Special Events Manager will play a critical role in shaping some of the most visible and globally broadcast moments of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. From milestone launches to the Final Draw, this position directly contributes to the tournament’s international perception, commercial success, and legacy in Brazil.

The successful candidate will demonstrate strong strategic vision, exceptional organizational and leadership skills, creative excellence, and the ability to operate effectively in a complex, fast‑paced, and multicultural environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Strategic Event Planning & Delivery

  • Official Dinner
  • Final Draw
  • Brand Launch
  • Mascot Launch
  • Team Workshop
  • Volunteers Kick‑Off Event
  • Guest activities, when required
  • Coordination of Legends Matches
  • Participation in pre‑match ceremonies
  • Additional milestone and stakeholder events throughout the tournament lifecycle
  • Develop comprehensive event strategies, timelines, and delivery frameworks to ensure consistent quality, innovation, and alignment with FIFA’s global positioning.

2. Creative Direction & Experience Design

  • Drive the creative vision and thematic development of each event in alignment with FIFA brand guidelines.
  • Oversee event concepts, production design, show flow, staging, entertainment, and guest experience.
  • Ensure all events reflect the prestige, inclusivity, and global significance of the FIFA Women’s World Cup™.

3. Operational & Logistical Oversight

  • Manage all operational aspects including venue selection, supplier procurement, production management, accreditation, guest services, protocol, and security coordination.
  • Ensure integrated planning across broadcast, marketing, communications, hospitality, and competition functions.
  • Implement detailed contingency and risk management plans to guarantee flawless delivery.

4. Budget & Financial Management

  • Develop, monitor, and control event budgets across multiple initiatives.
  • Optimize resource allocation while maintaining premium standards.
  • Manage vendor contracts and ensure cost efficiency, compliance, and financial transparency.

5. Stakeholder & Partner Coordination

  • Serve as the primary liaison for internal departments, Host Cities, commercial partners, sponsors, government authorities, and international delegations related to special events.
  • Coordinate with the FIFA Zurich Project Team to ensure alignment with global event standards and reporting structures.
  • Manage protocol requirements and high‑profile guest engagement including FIFA leadership, participating member associations, VIPs, and media.

6. Team Leadership & Management

  • Lead and mentor a multidisciplinary project team across different FIFA Functional Areas, fostering collaboration, accountability, and high performance.
  • Oversee external agencies and production partners, ensuring clear deliverables and performance standards.
  • Build a positive team culture aligned with FIFA values.

YOUR PROFILE

Education
  • A Master’s degree (MBA) in Event Management, Sports Management, Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, Hospitality Management, or a related field.
  • Additional executive education in large‑scale event production, leadership, or project management is advantageous.
Experience
  • Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive experience in large-scale international event management, preferably within global sporting events, major entertainment productions, or multinational organizations.
  • Proven experience leading high‑profile, broadcast‑level events such as draws, ceremonies, gala dinners, launches, or government-level functions.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multi‑million-dollar budgets and complex procurement processes.
  • Strong background in stakeholder management involving senior executives, sponsors, government authorities, and international delegations.
  • Experience working in matrix organizations and collaborating with global headquarters or international governing bodies is highly desirable.
  • Previous experience within FIFA tournaments or comparable mega‑events (e.g., Olympic Games, continental championships, global expos) is a strong advantage.
Skills & Competencies Strategic & Operational Excellence
  • Strong ability to translate strategic objectives into comprehensive event delivery plans.
  • Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple large-scale initiatives simultaneously.
  • Advanced knowledge of event production, show calling, staging, audiovisual integration, and broadcast requirements.
Leadership & Team Management
  • Proven leadership capability with experience managing multidisciplinary teams and external agencies.
  • Ability to inspire, mentor, and drive high performance in fast‑paced environments.
  • Strong decision‑making skills under pressure.
Financial & Commercial Acumen
  • Solid budget planning, financial oversight, and cost‑control expertise.
  • Understanding of sponsorship integration and brand alignment within event environments.
Communication & Stakeholder Engagement
  • Excellent interpersonal and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to manage high‑level protocol and VIP relations with professionalism and discretion.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in Portuguese and/or Spanish is highly desirable.
Personal Attributes
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and solutions-driven.
  • Resilient and adaptable in dynamic, multicultural environments.
  • Creative mindset with strong attention to brand experience and innovation.
  • High integrity and alignment with FIFA’s values of inclusion, teamwork, and excellence.
Requiriments
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose / ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Líder de Consultoria e Processos

Resumo do Propósito da Função :

Como um contribuinte fundamental para a excelência operacional, o Consultor de Processos & Melhoria Contínua (CI) conduz iniciativas impactantes de melhoria de processos em toda a organização. Atuando como um assessor de confiança, este cargo é responsável por padronizar, implementar e otimizar processos críticos para aumentar a eficiência e o desempenho. Utilizando sua expertise em melhoria contínua, o consultor garante que as soluções estejam alinhadas aos objetivos organizacionais e entreguem resultados mensuráveis e sustentáveis, promovendo uma cultura de inovação e progresso contínuo.

O Consultor Interno de Processos & CI trabalha em estreita colaboração com o Head de Consultoria de Processos, assegurando alinhamento com a estratégia global e contribuindo para os objetivos mais amplos estabelecidos no plano de 5 anos (5YP) e em outras iniciativas estratégicas de negócios.

Responsabilidades :

  • Desenho Excelência Operacional e Otimização de Processos : apoiar e conduzir iniciativas de melhoria de processos destinadas a elevar a excelência operacional, simplificando processos, estimulando a inovação, melhorando a eficiência e desenvolvendo novas formas de trabalho. Realizar análises detalhadas para identificar ineficiências e oportunidades de melhoria nos processos existentes, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos organizacionais. Assegurar que as mudanças sejam sustentáveis, implementadas de forma eficaz e que seu impacto no desempenho seja mensurável.
  • Desenho e Otimização de Processos End-to-End (E2E) : atuar como consultor no design e implementação de processos operacionais eficientes, garantindo a criação de soluções robustas e escaláveis que ampliem o desempenho operacional em toda a organização. Ter um papel fundamental na tomada de decisões operacionais, garantindo que os processos sejam concebidos para serem replicáveis e adaptáveis em diferentes regiões e contextos. Oferecer suporte e assistência contínua no desenvolvimento de soluções operacionais personalizadas, alinhadas ao pipeline de desenvolvimento de Operações & TI, agilizando processos, sistemas e ferramentas para criar um ambiente de trabalho mais eficiente e eficaz.
  • Colaboração Multifuncional : atuar como elo entre as operações locais para facilitar o trabalho colaborativo entre equipes, assegurando alinhamento e compartilhamento de conhecimento para promover uma cultura de processos padronizados, disseminação de boas práticas e melhoria contínua.

Engajar-se ativamente e apoiar a rede de colaboradores treinados para impulsionar projetos contínuos de melhoria de processos, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos organizacionais e entregando ganhos de desempenho mensuráveis.

Competências :

  • Adaptar o estilo de comunicação para transmitir mensagens de forma eficaz a diferentes públicos dentro das equipes e a stakeholders, garantindo clareza e promovendo compreensão nas interações do dia a dia.

  • Influenciar de forma eficaz colegas e membros da equipe para obter apoio às iniciativas de melhoria de processos, utilizando persuasão e colaboração para garantir alinhamento e implementação bem-sucedida das mudanças.

Para facilitar o seu dia a dia:

  • Convênio com restaurantes;
  • Cartão de crédito multicompras;

  • Metodologia Balance aplicada junto a liderança e time fortalecendo a comunicação e reconhecimento, bem-estar e estilo de trabalho/ferramentas.

Fundado em 1986 a Ser promove e impulsiona ações voltadas ao bem-estar e desenvolvimento social e cultural. Os colaboradores sócios contam com serviços diferenciados, clube de descontos e vantagens com mais de 200 empresas parceiras nas áreas de educação, saúde, alimentação, lazer e entretenimento. Veja nossos principais convênios!

  • Plano odontológico;
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Desconto em farmácias de até 35%
  • Convênio para Pet;
  • Ingressos de cinemas e muito mais.

Pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas em todas as nossas oportunidades.

Etapas do processo

  • Cadastro
  • Triagem
  • Entrevista Gestor
  • Contratação

Sobre a Lojas Renner

O que é que te encanta? ❤️

Muito além da maior varejista de moda do país, somos um Ecossistema no qual criamos o futuro, inovamos e solucionamos diferentes desafios. Todos os dias aprendemos algo novo, desenvolvemos habilidades e aprimoramos talentos.

Aqui, temos o sentimento de pertencimento, respeitamos o diverso e trabalhamos em um ambiente no qual cuidamos e somos cuidados. Nossa consciência ambiental e social está presente em todas as ações, pois temos compromisso claro com os colaboradores, clientes e fornecedores. Juntos, levamos Encantamento às mais de 600 lojas nos cinco estados do Brasil, além de Argentina e Uruguai.

Se o que te encanta é poder aprender, compartilhar e ensinar. Se o que te encanta é o respeito, a diversidade e a inclusão. Seu lugar é aqui.

Junte-se ao time de 24 mil colaboradores que estão reunidos para encantar ao lado das marcas Renner, Camicado, Youcom, Ashua, Repassa e Realize.

title: Farmacotécnico Jr
description:
• Realizar consultas em literaturas referentes aos componentes da formulação, técnicas sobre o processo de fabricação da forma farmacêutica definida, medicamento referência (quando aplicável,) bem como das diretrizes regulatórias;
  • Auxiliar na elaboração da sequência de atividades de desenvolvimento dos novos produtos ou às melhorias dos produtos de linha, de acordo com o preconizado na legislação vigente, permitindo o bom andamento das atividades sem retrabalhos para atender aos prazos;
  • Avaliar e propor, junto com os farmacotécnicos sênior e a coordenação, qualitativamente e quantitativamente os componentes das fórmulas de novos produtos e / ou ajustes das formulações dos produtos de linha, bem como dos processos de fabricação, baseando-se no levantamento bibliográfico obtendo um produto que atenda as especificações desejadas;
  • Elaborar ou modificar, junto aos analista sênior e a coordenação, as instruções de fabricação (IF) dos lotes pilotos de bancada, semi-industrial ou de linha, assim como lista técnica e receita mestre, de acordo com a fórmula e processos definidos;
  • Manipular os lotes de bancada em laboratório conforme fórmula e processo proposto e de acordo com as normas de Boas Práticas de Fabricação (BPF) e Boas Práticas de Laboratório (BPL);
  • Acompanhar todas as etapas do processo de fabricação do lote piloto semi-industrial ou lotes para venda, quando necessário, orientando os operadores quanto aos parâmetros e dúvidas em geral;
  • Auxiliar na orientação técnica à Produção (suporte, troubleshooting), a investigação de desvios e as análises de controles de mudança, quando solicitado pelas áreas parceiras;
  • Elaborar, com apoio dos analistas sênior e a da coordenação, as documentações técnicas referentes ao processo de desenvolvimento e ao produto (novo ou de linha) como relatórios de desenvolvimento da formulação e processo, relatório de produção, relatório de acompanhamento de produto, através dos resultados dos testes de bancada, semi-industrial ou industrial;

Elaborar procedimentos operacionais padrão, de acordo com manuais de equipamentos e conhecimentos técnicos, para padronizar as atividades do setor garantindo a correta utilização dos equipamentos.

Para fazer acontecer, você precisa (Mandatórios) :

Superior completo em Farmácia.

Possuir Pós-graduação em Industria Farmacêutica.

Modelo de trabalho : Presencial em Santo Amaro | Seg / Qui 12 : 30 às 22 : 00 Sex 12 : 30 às 19 : 30

Oferecemos :

  • Assistência Médica
  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Auxilio Creche (Exclusivo para Mulheres)
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Previdência Privada
  • Vale Alimentação
  • Vale Transporte ou Estacionamento
  • Gympass (Wellhub)

Na Apsen , incentivamos a participação de pessoas negras, mulheres, LGBTQIA+, 50+ e pessoas com deficiência. Temos o compromisso em promover diversidade, e acreditamos ser o caminho para a construção de um mundo melhor e mais justo, e que precisa ser começado dentro da nossa própria casa, então, junte-se à Nação Azul !

title: Assistente de Loja - Américas Shopping
description:
Descrição da vaga

Que tal entrar para o nosso #TimedeCampeões ?

Aqui é lugar de gente que tem sede de vitória, é apaixonado por esporte, acredita no trabalho em equipe e está disposto a correr junto com os nossos clientes.

Se você é uma pessoa organizada, tem senso de espaço e um bom olhar para entender.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Dar aquele talento na loja e mantê-la sempre preparada para os nossos clientes, na parte de vestuário e acessórios.

Ter agilidade e dinamismo para atuar nos diferentes setores da loja.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Médio completo
  • Boa comunicação
  • Vontade de aprender e sede de crescimento as necessidades da loja, essa posição é para você.
  • Você vai garantir que tudo esteja impecável, do atendimento ao estoque, deixando nossos clientes super satisfeitos.

Informações adicionais

A Centauro é a maior empresa de artigos esportivos da América Latina. Nossa maior missão é mobilizar pessoas e transformar vidas por meio do esporte, por isso, nos orgulhamos da nossa trajetória, que iniciou em 1981 e resultou em nossas mais de 220 lojas, presentes em todas as regiões do Brasil.

Por aqui, cada jogada é ensaiada e nossos craques contam com técnicos, líderes de lojas e todas as ferramentas necessárias para uma visão estratégica de jogo!

O clima em loja é de descontração, mas quando chega a hora da partida, cada craque veste a camisa da sua posição e joga junto dos clientes. E se você precisar de ajuda, saiba que nosso time #jogaentrosado , afinal, aqui #miramosotopo .

Muito mais que uma loja, a Centauro é um lugar de histórias escritas por vencedores. Vem fazer seu nome, vem fazer parte do nosso #TimeDeCampeões .

SOBRE NÓS

Nós somos a Centauro, uma empresa do Grupo SBF.

Queremos ser reconhecidos na sociedade como a marca que movimenta o mercado esportivo para um novo patamar, contribuindo com o aumento da atividade física no Brasil. Estamos presentes em 26 estados, com 226 lojas próprias espalhadas pelo Brasil.

Somos convictos, acreditamos em mobilizar pessoas pela força da nossa essência.

Somos fazedores, acreditamos em mobilizar pessoas com ações práticas.

Somos saudavelmente inconformados, acreditamos em mobilizar pessoas a fazerem mais e melhor.

Somos criadores, acreditamos que sendo curiosos e tendo sede pelo novo, vamos criar o que ainda não foi feito.

Movimentar é o nosso esporte

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

As an Editor at Darkroom, your primary duty will be to develop and assist in the development of marketing collateral, including video content and organic content. Our Editors add immense value to our client's work through native content and strategies. The ideal candidate is someone who is passionate about using their editing skills to tell a compelling story and help our customers grow their businesses.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, and Spain.

Who You Are:

  • Experience creating platform native content (including video content and organic content), especially IG Reels, Meta ads, and TikTok viral video campaigns

  • Familiarity with broadcast finishing workflows (mix, color, VFX, conform, online)

  • Strong technical knowledge of codecs and transcoding practices

  • Strong time management skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong communication skills

  • Proficient with animation/ graphic design preferred

What You'll Do:

  • You will be editing UGC-style videos in a variety of content formats

  • Develop and execute thumb-stopping social media video edits, layer audio seamlessly and overlay text that drives key brand messaging

  • Brainstorm inventive edits and hooks that drive engagement, leverage new formats

  • Stay current on all social media platforms, ad offerings, content publishers, tools, trends, and best practices

  • Be a creative collaborator: Have the ability to be the voice of the brand and the influencer to create content that is authentic and powerful for all channels

  • Be comfortable using video editing software, editing audio, and taking editing direction, while working in a fast pace environment

  • Provide accessible content that includes closed captioning, voiceover, and overlay text in a variety of aspect ratios

  • Setting up projects for edit staff

  • Editing lower-level projects

  • Maintaining media storage (hard drives, servers, GDrive)

  • Mastering deliverables and archiving projects

  • Versioning various aspect ratios of completed edits

  • Maintaining all software and assets (Mac OSX, server operating system, frame.io, Vimeo, shared assets)

  • Coordinating and troubleshooting edit equipment

  • Reporting to the Post-Production Supervisor and Producers, the AE will upon request create high-quality video edits that will span various media platforms

  • Performance creative editing (collaborating with the performance marketing team in reviewing ad analytics/performance)

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

  • Experiência consumindo APIs REST e integrando com serviços externos, incluindo tratamento de erros e lógica de autenticação.

  • Vivência com ferramentas da Firebase Suite: Crashlytics, Analytics, Performance, Remote Config e Cloud Messaging.
  • Experiência com CI/CD para mobile/Flutter (ex.: CodeMagic, pipelines de integração e entrega contínua).
  • Noções sólidas de qualidade de código: organização, tratamento de erros, logging estruturado e atenção à performance.
  • +5 anos de experiência prática com Flutter/Dart

DIFERENCIAIS:

  • Implementação de Design System proprietário, componentes reutilizáveis, tematização e animações com Lottie.
  • Experiência com Analytics (AppsFlyer, Firebase Analytics, Insider) e Deep Linking (App Links, Universal Links, URL schemes).
  • Experiência com WebViews (InAppWebView customizada, WebView Flutter) e Push Notifications (Firebase Messaging, Flutter Local Notifications).

description:
Promotor Social - Rio de Janeiro/RJ

ASSOCIACAO VOLUNTARIOS PARA O SERVICO INTERNACIONAL - BRASIL

Vaga afirmativa para Mulheres

CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana.

Nesse contexto, a AVSI Brasil será responsável pela operacionalização de um projeto em parceria com a Águas do Rio, concessionária de distribuição de água potável que atua no município do Rio de Janeiro e na Baixada Fluminense. O projeto visa promover atividades de mobilização social, organização comunitária e ações educativas, com o objetivo de engajar e integrar as comunidades atendidas.

As atividades planejadas incluem ações de conscientização sobre as obras e iniciativas sociais do Rio, realizadas por meio de abordagens lúdicas, participativas e imersivas, voltadas para crianças, jovens e adultos. O objetivo é fortalecer o diálogo com as comunidades, promover a transparência, incentivar a participação social e consolidar uma relação de confiança entre a concessionária e a população local, contribuindo para a eficácia das ações e para o bem‑estar das comunidades envolvidas.

DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO:

O Promotor(a) Social será responsável por planejar, executar e mediar ações educativas e socioculturais na área do Projeto Água do Rio, trabalhando diretamente com as comunidades atendidas, com foco em experiências lúdicas, participativas e imersivas.

Realizar o mapeamento dos atores públicos e privados nas áreas de implementação das atividades do projeto.

Organizar atividades e eventos, incluindo agendas, articulação local e divulgação;

Desenvolver espaços voltados para crianças, jovens e adultos, promovendo o envolvimento do público de forma acessível, inclusiva e participativa;

Criar, adaptar e aplicar oficinas participativas, utilizando metodologias interativas e conteúdo alinhado aos temas do patrocinador, como saneamento básico, tratamento de água, saúde ambiental e sustentabilidade;

Desenvolver dinâmicas educativas que estimulem a reflexão, o diálogo e a participação ativa do público, respeitando as especificidades de cada faixa etária;

Atuar como mediador entre o conteúdo do projeto e a comunidade, facilitando a compreensão das mensagens-chave por meio de jogos, experiências, rodas de conversas e atividades práticas;

Apoiar ações realizadas em espaços educativos, culturais ou comunitários, garantindo uma abordagem educativa, de apoio e alinhada aos objetivos institucionais do Projeto Água do Rio;

Realizar pesquisas de satisfação com o público participante;

Preparar e apresentar relatórios qualitativos das atividades e eventos realizados;

Consolidar relatórios periódicos de acompanhamento das ações;

Colaborar com a equipe técnica da organização, prestar suporte e registrar as experiências e atividades realizadas.

  • Graduação

  • Disponibilidade para trabalho nos finais de semana e feriados - Avançado
  • Flexibilidade, organização e proatividade; - Avançado
  • Habilidades com softwares do pacote office (Word, Excel e Power Point). - Intermediário

  • Experiência na condução de oficinas recreativas, educativas e participativas , dirigidas a diferentes públicos (crianças, jovens e adultos). - Avançado

title: Vice President, Business Development
description:
The Vice President Business Development individually drives market position and achievement of business outcomes through the Demand and Account Management/Commercial Operations Core Process. This position is a senior level, core sales position within the company responsible for new business/clients as well as managing/leveraging existing accounts. The Vice President Business Development drives results through individual and collective team sales efforts. The position is responsible for leveraging collaboration with internal teams such as marketing, engineering/survey, and product development and technology groups in order to drive service and business outcomes. The Vice President Business Development also contributes to strategic initiatives and planning through an extensive knowledge of market conditions within their assigned specific location or group of locations, country or group of countries, market sector, and/or product(s).

What You Will Do:

  • Execute and drive sales strategies in the assigned area of responsibility and meet or exceed sales and revenue targets with a focus on the marine area.
  • Support the Product & Digital Solution Development, Survey & Certification, Engineering Delivery, and Rule Development Core Processes as needed to achieve organizational business outcomes.
  • Develop and maintain key client relationships with a focus on maintaining current work and expanding new business opportunities and prospect for new clients and business opportunities within your assigned responsibility in marine sector
  • Lead the development of visit plans for assigned clients and area of responsibility, to include organizing client meetings for ABS senior management
  • Execute the Demand and Account Management / Commercial Operations Core Process as appropriate within the assigned area of responsibility
  • Maintains awareness of the overall ABS service portfolio and promote services/products when appropriate, ensuring peers and teams outside your core responsibility are aware of potential opportunities and needed action
  • Provide strategic insight within the assigned area or responsibility related to future business initiatives, market drivers, and competitor activities for inclusion in business planning
  • Work with organizational teams to develop capture strategies, proposals and pricing as appropriate
  • Work with technical staff and other internal teams as needed to meet customer needs.
  • Attend industry events and conferences, and provide feedback and information on market and creative trends.
  • Identify opportunities for marketing campaigns within the area of responsibility that will lead to increased sales.
  • Submit reports as needed and ensure data is accurately entered and managed within the company’s CRM
  • Forecast sales targets and track activity on accounts to meet these targets

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business or in an engineering technical field is required
  • MBA or engineering postgraduate degree is preferred
  • Over 20 years of experience in marine sector
  • Typically 7 or more years of experience in the assigned area of responsibility or market sector is required
  • International experience, either as an expatriate or working with international projects and teams, is required
  • Previous experience in business development or sales in a technical and diverse product environment is preferred

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Demonstrated acumen for sales, business development, and account management with experience in meeting and/or exceeding sales targets preferred
  • Demonstrated proficiency in developing strategic customer relationships.
  • Strong leadership presence and the ability to quickly establish and build credibility and relationships, externally as well as internally to ABS
  • Excellent business judgment, including the ability to assess the reasonableness and likelihood of success of various business scenarios
  • Demonstrated technical acumen related to the product or area of responsibility
  • A self-starter with a demonstrated desire achieve goals and as well as a collaborative personality who effectively works with teams and individuals to achieve organizational business outcomes

Reporting Relationships:

Reports directly to the Senior Vice President

A SGS é uma Multinacional Suiça, líder mundial em Inspeção, Verificação, Testes e Certificação, somos reconhecidos por nossa qualidade e integridade. Estamos presentes em mais de 140 países, com 99.600 colaboradores no mundo, contamos com 2.650 escritórios e laboratórios. Nosso time no Brasil possui aproximadamente 4.000 colaboradores, distribuídos nas 5 unidades de negócios, sendo elas:

Industries & Environment - Possibilitando infraestrutura, transporte e indústrias mais seguras, sustentáveis e ecológicas. Health & Nutrition – Trabalhamos para ampliar a segurança, qualidade e sustentabilidade dos produtos alimentares, de saúde e bem-estar. Os clientes precisam saber que os alimentos que ingerem, os medicamentos, os produtos cosméticos e de higiene que utilizam são seguros e não os prejudicam. Os recursos naturais são essenciais para o desenvolvimento econômico e fundamentais para a vida cotidiana. Connectivity & Products – Possibilitando produtos e serviços melhores e mais seguros. À medida que o mundo se torna mais conectado, marcas, fabricantes, varejistas e governos devem garantir a segurança, a qualidade e a conformidade regulatória de seus produtos e serviços. Fornecemos a gama mais abrangente do mundo de serviços de inspeção, teste, certificação e consultoria, com tecnologia de ponta e ferramentas digitais. Nossa rede global de especialistas oferece suporte em todas as etapas – desde o projeto, produção e conformidade regulamentar até a importação e exportação de mercadorias.

Business Assurance – Transformar os negócios e viabilizar o crescimento sustentável aprimorando conhecimento, habilidades e processos com certificação, auditorias de fornecedores, avaliações de sustentabilidade, consultoria e treinamento. Em uma economia cada vez mais globalizada, sua organização deve manter-se atualizada com as complexas obrigações regulatórias, padrões e melhores práticas para reduzir os riscos jurídicos, financeiros e reputacionais. Com a expertise e o conhecimento de nossa equipe, trabalhando com processos e ferramentas avançadas, ajudamos organizações a melhorar resultados, gerenciar riscos, cumprir mudanças regulatórias e adotar melhores práticas, além de capacitar, tanto o profissional autônomo ou in-company, através do SGS Academy.

Valorizamos a inovação, excelência e colaboração em tudo o que fazemos. Somos uma das maiores empresas de serviços do mundo, em Auditoria, Consultoria, Impostos, Estratégia e Transações, orientados à Tecnologia. Com presença em mais de 150 países, aqui você terá a oportunidade de viver as experiências excepcionais que só a EY pode oferecer, com alcance global, cultura inclusiva e tecnologia para se tornar a sua melhor versão.

A Graphic Designer is responsible for creating compelling visual content that communicates a brand’s message effectively, captures attention, and engages its target audience. This role requires a blend of creative vision, design expertise, and technical proficiency to produce high-quality visuals across multiple platforms and formats.

Scope of Work

Graphic Designers work on a variety of projects, including digital and print media —such as social media graphics, website layouts, online advertisements, email templates, presentations, infographics, packaging, brochures, and event materials. Required Technical Skills

Proficiency in industry-standard design software—such as Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), Figma, or Canva —is essential. A strong understanding of design principles, user experience (UX), and current design trends enables Graphic Designers to produce innovative and effective visuals.

Additional Responsibilities

Beyond design creation, Graphic Designers may be involved in maintaining brand asset libraries, preparing files for print or digital publication, and ensuring compliance with production specifications . They also review feedback, make revisions, and manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines.

Required Qualifications

To excel in this role, a Graphic Designer needs exceptional attention to detail, creativity, time management, and communication skills , as well as the ability to balance artistic innovation with practical business objectives.

title: SDR (Sales Development Representative) BRA (Remote)
description:
A Sales Development Representative (SDR) plays a critical role in driving revenue growth by identifying, engaging, and qualifying potential customers for the company’s products or services. As the first point of contact in the sales process, SDRs are responsible for creating a strong pipeline of opportunities that fuels the success of the sales team.

This role involves researching and segmenting target markets , identifying decision-makers within organizations, and using multiple outreach channels—such as cold calls, personalized emails, LinkedIn messaging, and social media engagement —to connect with prospects. SDRs must understand each prospect’s industry, challenges, and goals to effectively tailor their pitch and communicate the value proposition of the company’s offerings.

Beyond initiating contact, SDRs qualify leads based on specific criteria, ensuring that account executives receive prospects who are ready and able to engage in meaningful sales conversations. They also schedule discovery calls, product demos, or meetings , and document all interactions in the company’s CRM system to maintain an organized and up-to-date pipeline.

An effective SDR is goal-driven, resilient, and curious , able to handle rejection while staying motivated to meet or exceed key performance metrics such as outreach volume, response rates, and conversion rates. Collaboration with the marketing team is also essential, as SDRs often provide feedback on campaign performance and prospect insights to improve lead generation efforts.

Success in this role requires exceptional communication skills , both written and verbal, strong active listening abilities, and the capacity to quickly learn and articulate the benefits of complex products or services. SDRs who excel not only open doors for new business but also build lasting relationships that can lead to long-term customers and sustainable company growth.

title: Planning and Integration Manager
description:
Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Administration

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

This role focuses on coordinating operational planning, integration, risk and issue management, to ensure successful delivery of the tournament, hosted in Brazil.

The Project Manager will work with internal and external stakeholders, including FIFA and FIFA27, host cities, government entities, and venue authorities, to achieve excellence in planning, readiness, and execution.

This position offers a unique opportunity to shape the success of one of the most prestigious global sporting events and leave a lasting legacy for women’s football in Brazil and beyond.

The Project Manager will be a key role during tournament time, coordinating day-to-day operations at the Tournament Operations Centre and coordinating with stakeholders to resolve issues.

Travel and flexibility to work irregular hours may be required due to the nature of the event.

Key Responsibilities

Project Management and Integration

  • Under the direction of FIFA’s Lead of FWWC Portfolio Management based in Zurich, implement the FIFA Project Management framework throughout the planning, readiness, implementation and closure phases of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 project.
  • Assist to implement project management processes and standards within FIFA27.
  • Coordinate cross-functional and venue teams to ensure the integration of operational, venue and client planning activities.
  • Collaborate with Functional Areas (FAs) in FIFA27, Host Cities, and stakeholders to develop and implement comprehensive function and venue operating plans (Project Definitions, Operations Plans and Site Operational Plans).
  • Assist in the development of tournament-wide contingency plans and ensure functional area and venue alignment.
  • Assist in the development and maintenance of the master project plan, critical roadmap from a FIFA27 perspective, capturing all key milestones and tasks and the monitoring thereof.
  • Provide strategic and operational support, including tracking progress, risk-issue monitoring, and milestone adherence.

Reporting

  • Assist in the delivery of the Tournament Operations Centre (TOC) structures and systems to facilitate coordination and issue resolution.
  • Provide regular updates and reporting to senior leadership and stakeholders on progress, risks and issues. Help to compile presentations to senior management
  • Compile standardised reports on project progress, risks, and dependencies to ensure alignment with governance structures
  • Data extraction, consolidation and visualisations

Operational and Client Planning

  • Coordinate the development of client and functional operating plans, policies, and procedures using FIFA templates.
  • Assist in the definition and integration of client journey plans in collaboration with key stakeholders.
  • Manage the agreement process for client service levels and priorities.
  • Ensure consistency in planning and delivery across competition and non-competition venues.
  • Support Functional Areas in FIFA27 in preparing and maintaining activity and event schedules, monitoring risks, issues, and resource requirements.

Risk Management

  • Enable risk management processes, including identification, mitigation, and escalation of risks and issues across FIFA27.
  • Ensure compliance with ISO 31000 standards for risk management.
  • Support the development of strategic contingency plans.
  • Work with Functional Areas in FIFA27 to ensure risks are identified, documented and mitigated effectively.

Operational Readiness

  • Plan and conduct readiness exercises, including simulations, rehearsals, and testing of infrastructure, systems, and processes.
  • Build the capability of functional area and venue teams through tailored readiness activities.
  • Capture and implement lessons learned from readiness activities to optimize tournament delivery.
  • Prepare for tournament time by transitioning into the day-to-day coordination and issue management role within the Main Operations Centre.

Knowledge Management

  • Contribute to FIFA’s knowledge management initiatives, including the Observer Program, debriefs, lessons capture, and post-tournament reporting.
  • Ensure proper transfer of knowledge through documentation, photo capture, and archiving of key materials for future events.

Training and Development

  • Provide training to FIFA27 users on FIFA’s project management methodology and tools.
  • Ensure consistent application of project management principles across the organization.

Your Profile

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Business, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Knowledge of event planning and project management processes.
  • Familiarity with various project management methodologies, including Agile and Scrum, is an advantage.

Experience

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in leading complex, large-scale projects, preferably in international mega-events or sports events.
  • Proven track record in developing and executing strategic and operational plans.
  • Experience managing stakeholder relationships across government, corporate, and community groups.
  • Expertise in project and risk management, issue management, operational readiness, and contingency planning.
  • Experience in tournament time operations, including incident management and resolution.
  • Experience working in cross-functional, multi-stakeholder and multi-cultural environments.

Certifications

  • Professional certifications such as PMP, APM, or Prince2 is required.

Skills & Competencies

  • Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
  • Experience with project management tools is an asset.
  • A good proficiency in visualisation tools such as Power BI or Tableau for reporting.
  • Familiarity with collaboration tools and systems for managing complex projects.

Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Recruiter BRA (Remote)
description:
A Recruiter is responsible for identifying, attracting, and hiring top talent to meet an organization’s staffing needs, ensuring that each hire aligns with both the technical requirements and the cultural values of the company. This role involves proactively sourcing candidates through a variety of channels, including job boards, professional networks, social media platforms, recruitment agencies, industry events, and employee referrals.

Once potential candidates are identified, the Recruiter screens applications, conducts initial assessments, and manages interview processes to evaluate skills, experience, and fit. They work closely with hiring managers to define job requirements, craft compelling job descriptions, and establish selection criteria that lead to strong matches.

The role extends beyond simply filling positions—it also involves managing the entire recruitment lifecycle from initial contact to offer negotiation and onboarding. This includes coordinating interviews, providing feedback to candidates, ensuring timely communication, and guiding both candidates and hiring teams through each stage of the process. A strong focus on candidate experience is key, as positive interactions contribute to the employer’s brand and long-term talent pipeline.

In many cases, Recruiters also track and analyze hiring metrics—such as time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, and source effectiveness—to refine strategies and improve overall recruitment efficiency. They stay informed about labor market trends, competitive compensation data, and evolving recruitment technologies, adapting approaches to remain competitive in attracting top talent.

To excel, a Recruiter must combine exceptional communication and interpersonal skills with strategic thinking, organization, and relationship-building capabilities. Their work plays a critical role in shaping the company’s workforce, influencing its ability to grow, innovate, and succeed.

title: Engineering Manager, MAAS
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager as we expand the MAAS team . Our mission with MAAS ("Metal as a Service") is to provide the best solution for building and running private bare-metal infrastructure, putting a cloud-style on-demand API in front of physical server provisioning, network configuration, and storage. We are hiring engineering managers with experience in high-quality software development and high-performance team leadership who also have deep familiarity with Linux on physical servers, Linux storage and data center networking capabilities.

The Canonical MAAS team is responsible for delivering our Metal As A Service (MAAS) hyperscale provisioning technology. Ubuntu strives to be the most scalable, cloud ready server distribution and MAAS is our platform to get Ubuntu on bare metal servers. MAAS is a rapidly evolving software stack written in Python and Go. Its components span the entire software stack: from low-level hardware detection and provisioning, to the upper level management web interface, API, and CLI. Our most effective engineers are fluent in all these layers, and able to anticipate the consequences of design and engineering choices elsewhere in a complex distributed system.

Canonical is seeking passionate technical leaders who are eager to drive innovation in one of Canonical's flagship data center products. You will play a key role in reshaping the future of data center technology through open source management platforms. MAAS aims to revolutionize data center management at scale starting from day zero deployment to long term data center expansion and maintenance.

Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop engineers, positively influence team and company culture, facilitate technical delivery, and guide strategy and execution. In addition to these responsibilities, you will be expected to collaborate across engineering. The MAAS team regularly interfaces with teams responsible for cloud-init, LXD, and our public cloud offerings.

The successful candidate will have technical leadership attributes and can demonstrate the ability to solve challenging distributed systems problems.

Location : This is a work-from-anywhere position available in EMEA or the Americas.

What we are looking for in you

  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) and a background in Computer Science
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Proven experience delivering software using Python, Golang, or similar languages
  • Experience with Linux system administration (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Familiarity with modern Linux cloud computing technologies, including networking, storage, containers and K8S
  • Technical aptitude for understanding complex distributed systems
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with agile software development methodologies
  • Ability to mentor, develop, and support team members
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long

Nice-to-have skills

  • Typescript using modern web frameworks such as React, Angular, Svelte or Vue
  • Data Center infrastructure management and design

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we\'ve been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

title: Data Architect
description: About You You are a Data Architect with a strong focus on designing, optimizing, and scaling high-performance data solutions. You enjoy working close to the database layer and understanding how architectural decisions directly impact performance, scalability, and reliability. You are comfortable owning data architecture decisions end to end and thrive in environments where deep technical expertise, autonomy, and collaboration with engineering teams are essential. You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience. 5+ years of experience in data architecture, database architecture, or similar roles with a strong focus on performance optimization. Hands-on experience designing and operating data solutions on AWS, with strong preference for RDS and Aurora. Advanced expertise in SQL, including complex query optimization, execution plan analysis, indexing strategies, and stored procedure development. Deep understanding of how CPU, memory, storage, and I/O constraints impact database and data architecture performance. Experience defining and applying architectural best practices for high availability, scalability, and performance. Strong proficiency using GitHub for version control, collaboration, and documentation. Ability to work independently, take ownership of architectural decisions, and drive improvements end to end. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data quality and system performance. Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with distributed and US-based teams. You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities: Design, evolve, and maintain data architectures that prioritize performance, scalability, and reliability on AWS RDS and Aurora. Analyze and optimize database workloads through SQL performance tuning, query refactoring, and advanced indexing strategies. Identify architectural and infrastructure-level bottlenecks related to CPU, memory, storage, and I/O, proposing scalable solutions. Define and enforce data modeling and architectural standards for high-performance transactional and analytical workloads. Collaborate closely with software engineers and technical teams to ensure strong alignment between application and data layers. Establish and promote best practices for database performance monitoring, optimization, and reliability across environments. Review and optimize stored procedures and complex SQL logic from an architectural and performance perspective. Document data architecture decisions, performance guidelines, and optimization strategies. Act as a technical reference and advisor for data architecture and performance topics across teams. Support technical discussions with stakeholders by providing clear recommendations and trade-off analyses. Additional Information About Us At Applaudo, we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive. We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable. Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.
